summary: iOS PWA push notifications fully restored — sw.js, manifest.json, and permission flow all fixed
whatsNew: iOS PWA Push Notifications — sw.js now ships as a companion file so the Service Worker actually registers (previously 404'd silently)
manifest.json now linked in page head — required by iOS 16.4+ for Web Push to function
Startup permission request suppressed for Home Screen installs — iOS requires a user gesture, and the PWA prompt modal already handles that correctly
Event notifications now schedule inside the SW's confirmed .then() callback rather than a fixed 2-second blind delay

Per-action ✅ stubs on reminder cards — tapping an action button replaces only that button with a grayed stub while remaining actions stay active. Done — Dismiss and Save as Missed remain throughout. Full green completion state only after all actions logged or Done — Dismiss tapped.
fixes: Service Worker registration silently failing with 404 — sw.js file was never deployed
Web Push not qualifying on iOS 16.4+ — manifest.json was missing from page head
Non-gesture Notification.requestPermission() call on startup conflicting with the PWA permission modal flow on iOS
